titre: Qualifier un intitulé LinkedIn : fondateur, directeur, salarié, indépendant
description: Avant de payer un enrichissement ou d'envoyer un lead à un agent, Jev lit le titre LinkedIn (headline) et dit à quelle famille de rôle il appartient. C'est la question passée sur 5 079 intitulés le 21/09/2026 : 80,1 % d'accord avec gpt-4o-mini, 0,17 $, et Jev avait raison 4 fois sur 5 sur les désaccords tranchables.

role.instructions: Classify this LinkedIn headline to qualify a B2B lead. When several roles are separated by '|', '/', '·', '•', ',', 'and', 'et', '+' or line breaks, the FIRST role is the main one; decide on it. A CEO or President without other indication counts as fondateur (benefit of the doubt).

criteria.fondateur: Founded the company or runs it as its owner or top executive: Founder, Co-Founder, Fondateur, CEO, PDG, Président, Dirigeant, Owner, Entrepreneur, Gérant, Co-Gérant of an independent SME. Not a solo coaching or consulting activity.
criteria.directeur: Senior executive who is not the CEO, employed by a company: COO, CFO, CTO, CMO, any Chief X Officer, VP, Director, Directeur (général, commercial, opérations, d'agence), Head of X, Managing Director, Managing Partner, Partner or Associé in a firm, salaried DG of a large structure or subsidiary. A non-CEO C-level at an identifiable company stays directeur even if a 'Founder @ side project' follows.
criteria.salarie: Non-executive employee of a company: Manager, Product or Project Manager, Lead, Chef de projet, Responsable, Analyst, Developer, Engineer, internal Consultant, SDR, Sales Rep, Designer, Account Manager, Coordinator, Specialist, Conseiller. A title 'chez X' or '@ X' that is not a founder or director title.
criteria.independant: Sells their own services solo: freelance, independent consultant, auto-entrepreneur, solopreneur, solo coach or trainer, PhD or researcher, 'Founder' of a personal coaching, training or consulting micro-activity, or a headline written as a marketing promise ('J'aide les X à...', 'Expert en Y pour Z', 'Je booste...').
criteria.unclear: Impossible to decide: empty headline, initials only ('KP', 'XXX'), a follower count, or a bare list of skills without any role.
